CustomField.formula: IF( TODAY() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > 2, "🔴 " &TEXT(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) & " Tage", IF( TODAY() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > 1, "🟡 "& TEXT(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) & " Tage", "🟢 "& TEXT(TODAY() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)) & " Tage" ) )
CustomField.label: Lead Age
